definitions.explanation: The act of including or encompassing everything within a certain scope. Used as a noun meaning 'comprehensiveness' or as a modifier ({包括的|ほうかつてき}) meaning 'comprehensive' or 'all-inclusive.'

examples.japanese: {包括的|ほうかつてき}な{対策|たいさく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{両国|りょうこく}は{包括的|ほうかつてき}な{協定|きょうてい}を{結|むす}んだ。
examples.english: The two countries signed a comprehensive agreement.

examples.japanese: この{報告書|ほうこくしょ}は{問題|もんだい}を{包括的|ほうかつてき}に{分析|ぶんせき}している。
examples.english: This report analyzes the problems comprehensively.

notes:
{包括|ほうかつ} means to encompass or include everything within a scope. Most commonly encountered in the adjectival form {包括的|ほうかつてき} (comprehensive, all-inclusive).

FORMS:
- Noun: {包括|ほうかつ} (comprehensiveness, inclusion)
- Suru verb: {包括|ほうかつ}する (to encompass, to include)
- Na-adjective: {包括的|ほうかつてき}な (comprehensive)
- Adverb: {包括的|ほうかつてき}に (comprehensively)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {包括的|ほうかつてき}な{対策|たいさく} (comprehensive measures)
- {包括|ほうかつ}{協定|きょうてい} (comprehensive agreement)
- {包括的|ほうかつてき}な{見直|みなお}し (comprehensive review)
- {地域|ちいき}{包括|ほうかつ}ケア (comprehensive community care — a key welfare policy term)

REGISTER:
Formal. Frequently appears in political, legal, academic, and policy contexts. In everyday conversation, {全体的|ぜんたいてき} (overall) or {幅広|はばひろ}い (wide-ranging) are more natural.
